cap: Emission is sympathetic, from the hypogastric nerves at T10 to L2, and ejaculation is somatic, through the pudendal nerve at S2 to S4. Serotonin raises the ejaculation threshold, so SSRIs and clomipramine treat premature ejaculation and also cause delayed ejaculation as an adverse effect, with erections usually intact. Alpha-1 blockers, diabetic neuropathy and prostate surgery cause retrograde ejaculation instead.
